notes: Catgirl Prompt Builder catalog. Read by the web page (engine.js) and by the app (CatgirlStudio.Core).
A prompt starts from blocks.prompt. {{name}} resolves to: {{pose}} (the prefab's pose), a block, or a variable (the en text of the chosen option, expanded again).
{{list:a,b,c}} expands each item, drops the empty ones and joins the rest as 'x, y and z'. An item can be an option field ('bottom.socks'). Text that goes into a list has no commas.
{{var.field}} is another field of the option chosen for var; every option of that var must have the field.
An option with en '' says nothing, and a joining word before it (and/with/over) goes away with it.
options can name a shared list ('colors', 'patterns') instead of listing options.
multi: true -> the value is a list of ids, shown as chips; options with the same slot exclude each other.
Only the variables a prompt reaches are shown, so a piece or a style can open its own detail fields.
id is a stable key stored in favorites and image .json files: do not rename one that was used.
House rules: always an adult cat-girl, cute and cozy, never sensual (modest clothing, high necklines, skirts at the knee or longer).
